title: Ignore Cursor IDE config and remove committed environment file
body: ## Summary - add `.cursor/` to the IDE section of `.gitignore` for consistency with other IDE directories - remove the accidentally committed `.cursor/environment.json` from version control ## Verification - verified `.cursor/environment.json` was tracked before the fix via `git ls-files` - confirmed `.gitignore` now includes `.cursor/` - confirmed commit removes the tracked Cursor config file
